query: Consider the following context: How to rationally design composition of alloys with desired properties has always been an open and challenging question, especially for high-entropy alloy (HEA) which has huge selections of composition due to the feature of multi-principal elements. Although great efforts have been made in the past decades, such as approaches based on thermo-kinetic analysis and simulations, strategies to quick determine the optimal HEA composition remain lacking. In that context, which method can be used for design intrinsically strong, ductile, and low-weight refractory HEA (RHEA) compositions, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Machine learning-based approach can be used to design intrinsically strong, ductile, and low-weight refractory high-entropy alloy (RHEA) compositions.
generation.material_initial_state: Multi-principal element alloy system with varying compositions
generation.intervention: Machine learning model training with dataset of existing HEA compositions and their properties
generation.conditions: High-temperature and high-stress conditions for RHEA applications
generation.structural_mediator: Atomic-scale crystal structure and lattice distortion
generation.mechanism: Machine learning model prediction of optimal composition based on patterns in existing data
generation.predicted_outcome: 20% increase in strength-to-weight ratio compared to existing RHEA compositions
generation.baseline: State-of-the-art RHEA compositions reported in literature
generation.boundary: Compositional space of multi-principal element alloy system
generation.uncertainty: Limited availability of high-quality data for training machine learning models, and potential bias in model predictions

falsification_experiment.design: Composition screening using machine learning model and experimental validation of predicted RHEA compositions
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the predicted RHEA compositions do not show at least 15% increase in strength-to-weight ratio compared to state-of-the-art compositions, the hypothesis is falsified
